items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: But I showed him the list one time. I showed Cavett the list. And he said, “well how am I going to have time to look at all that?”

ctx.x: But I showed him the list one time. I showed Cavett the list. And he said, “well how am I going to have time to look at all that?” Because I’ve got I don’t know how many feet. But now you can’t get film and I can’t get a projector to play them. My projector broke so I borrowed a projector and put it on video. But there was a lot of material there. I don’t know. But you know what was funny was like Zero Mostel. He’d come up to the band and be doing all kinds of things and you could tell what he was saying by just…
And you’d back up the musical guests too.
